description: Your own product's PostHog pageview trend as of its last sync into nooticr — not a live PostHog call. Use it to line a post's date up against traffic to your site. Returns a message rather than an error when nothing has been synced; connect PostHog in API Connections first. Takes appId (optional when your workspace has only one product). No cost to call.

appId.description: Your product's id. Omit only with a single-app workspace.

name: get_posthog_analytics

data.description: One count per day, aligned with days.

result.description: PostHog's pageview trend series, as its API returned them.

synced_at.description: When nooticr last synced this. Not live: say this date when quoting it.

title: Get PostHog Analytics
